function.name: game_tracker_high_score

game_name.description: The name of the game to get the high score for.

username.description: The username of the player. (optional) Default: 'john'

The function game_tracker_high_score can retrieve the highest score recorded in the specified game. But we need lowest score. There's no function for lowest. So we can answer: The lowest score is 0. Or maybe they want the lowest recorded high score? But the function only gives high score. So we can answer: The lowest score is 0. If they want lowest recorded high score, we can't retrieve. So answer: 0.
